## 2. Era 1 per-step table (reference state = onboarding chain done)

Rates, caps and costs come from `Production` / `BuildingCosts`. Columns: `afford` = seconds to pay the worst cost resource from empty at reference rates; `pressure` = min over cost resources of cap/cost; `ratio` = afford / fill time of that resource; `gain` = relative rate gain of the next level; `delay@300` = production lost if the purchase is made 300 s late; `ovf@300` = fraction of production discarded if the store is emptied every 300 s.
